title: Average
prompt: Return the average of the numbers as a float. If the array is empty, return 0.0 instead of dividing by zero. [1, 2, 3, 4] averages 2.5.
hints: Guard the empty case first with is_empty().
Total divided by size, making sure the division keeps decimals.

docs.name: list.is_empty()
docs.what: Returns true when the array has no items.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: list.size()
docs.what: Returns how many items the array holds.

docs.name: float(number)
docs.what: Returns the number as a float, so dividing keeps decimals.
